note: restart_on_update is a consent key: read from the settings file only (a flag or CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_* value is ignored with the note 'restart_on_update: settings file only'); off, shadow or on, any other value off with a note and one config_invalid row; ident reports it as `restart`. A CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR naming another folder gives every consent key its safe value (restart off, relaunch off), unless that folder's settings.json is the consent folder's own settings.json (a symlink to it): the same file, so every consent key, relaunch_auto included, is read from it

steps.name: the settings file turns it on; ident reports it
a flag or env value is ignored, with the note
an invalid value is off, with a note and one config_invalid row

stdout_has: ^note: restart_on_update: not off, shadow or on, off used$

steps.name: a CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR with its own settings.json: safe values
the same folder in status: both consent keys safe, with the note

stdout_has: ^note: restart_on_update: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is not ~/\.claude, safe value used$
^note: relaunch_auto: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is not ~/\.claude, safe value used$

steps.name: a CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR whose settings.json is a link to the consent file: the same file, every consent key from it

stdout_has: ^automatic relaunch: shadow \(reports would-relaunch, runs nothing\) · relaunch_auto shadow$
